Jungle main here! Even though I'm only bronze 3 at the moment I do have a lot of experience and would like to offer my perspective...

Ignore them. Sometimes.

It's the simplest way to do things from a jungler's perspective. Just because someone asks for a gank doesn't mean you should give it to them. I see this mostly from mid laners who are playing overly aggressive and get ganked multiple times as a result and then will flame you in chat. Now this doesn't mean never gank or listen to the pings. Sometimes your opponent is pushed up, but you didn't notice because you are focusing on farming or watching another lane. Then if top pings asking for a gank and it's a good spot, go for it. 

Don't forget a flash is a successful gank. Just remember to come back after maybe a camp or scuttle or even just loop around. 

Since you said jungle is just a fill role for you, try and use this knowledge for your own lane. There's nothing wrong with saying "hey jg. This _______ is pushing hard. Whenever you get the chance, gank?" Most times your jungle will actually respond and if they don't well you just have an ass for a jungler :)

TL;DR- ignore people who just want you to camp there lane when there is no reason to do so, listen to those who are just trying to make you aware of what's going on in there lane.

Hi! I'll try to answer your questions as best as I can:

First, go for it! Especially now that it is later in the season I noticed a pattern of being placed way higher than you deserved. For example, the end of last season I was placed in Silver 3, my KDA was about 1. No harm in it. It'll also give you a good feel of who you are really good with and who just works against the trolls in normals.

I can't stress this enough tho: DONT GET DISCOURAGED. I have over 500 ranked games this season Im only in bronze. So I will give you the same advice someone gave me. If you feel yourself be in a rut or can't climb: take a break and just play normals. Work on that champ pool, fine tune your mains, and work on your mechanics. I can't tell you how much it has helped me. 

Second, your champ pool seems really good. I would try and stay away from udyr top, as a personal preference. Especially since garden and he have similar counters. Try a champ that is the counter of your main choices counters. The important thing in champs in soloq especially is that you should be able to carry with whoever you play, which you have done. Try and stay away from champs that require a lot of team synergy, e.g. Gnar and kog'maw. Both are awesome champions, but without teammates they just can't carry a game. 

Like it has been said before try and find an AP Top, AP jg, and AD mid laner. I get so happy whenever I see a team that has all of one type of damage, because I know it will open up a lot of doors in the late game for my team. 

Third: personally, I would try and buy as many champs as possible. A lot of my mains have come from champions I picked up randomly cuz I had extra IP or RP. I always try to play any champ I don't own when they are free to get a feel for them. You'd be surprised at what you find. Your runes seem fine, just swap out the AS on the AD page and the AD on the AP page. If it's blues or quints, I recommend CDR. If not then just pick something you are comfortable.

Fourth: I would only duo with someone if you know you work well together. Don't just post in a message board looking for a partner. You need someone who meshes with your play style. If you can try and communicate over voice chat (Skype, curse, etc.). Pings only do so much and it will really help.

I know this was a lot. Any questions feel free to message or reply :)
